observations: Global Cobros y cartera now lists pending and overdue portfolio rows, but visible row actions still say Confirmar cobro instead of Aplicar pago.
Reported-payment rows also render Confirmar cobro instead of the application wording.
Cliente 360 > Recibos y pagos shows Confirmar cobro across actionable receipt rows; a transient alternate button is visible during rerender, proving competing owners.
Cliente 360 > Recibos y pagos should be application-only; payment reconciliation belongs in Cliente 360 > Cobros.
Cliente 360 > Cobros has reconciliation state but no Conciliar action for applied-unreconciled payments.
Global Cobros y cartera is intentionally combined, so row action must resolve by state: Aplicar pago before payment, Conciliar after payment when unreconciled.
The global count showed 0 cobros while simultaneously listing hundreds of portfolio receipts, which is misleading for a combined list.

rootCause.legacyRuntimeOverride: policy-receipts-v1199-bridge.js reassigns cob.aplicarPago=openPayment and cob.conciliarFactura=openReconciliationProposal after cobros.js loads, bypassing the canonical B3-004 owner.
rootCause.cliente360CompetingRenderers: cliente360.js fallback still contains Confirmar cobro semantics while the V920 owner paints Aplicar pago; rerenders can expose/finalize the legacy wording.
rootCause.surfaceBoundary: V920 Recibos y pagos exposes reconciliation action for already-paid receipts, while Cliente360 Cobros lacks the corresponding Conciliar action.
rootCause.combinedCount: cobros.js count header counts only materialized cobros although the table unions portfolio-only receipts and reported evidence.

behavior: Recibos y pagos is application-only: Aplicar pago for unpaid/reportable receipts; paid receipts show Pago aplicado and no Conciliar button.
Cliente 360 > Cobros lists materialized paid cobros and exposes Conciliar only for applied-unreconciled payments.
Global Cobros y cartera uses Aplicar pago before payment and Conciliar after payment when unreconciled.
The legacy v1.199 payment/reconciliation override is disabled; modules/cobros.js remains the runtime command owner.
The combined list header reports visible records rather than misleading 0 cobros when portfolio-only receipts are present.
Asset query versions are bumped so the corrected owners cannot be masked by stale asset reuse.
